scenarios.title: Revocation races a late cache fill
scenarios.summary: Follow one old read across revocation. A bounded stale hit is allowed; copying the value never extends its original deadline.

steps.title: A read obtains an active snapshot
steps.explanation: The authority returns version 1. Its permission ends at t=30, measured from this read's start. The response is deliberately held back to expose a race.

steps.title: Owner commits revocation
steps.explanation: The authoritative mapping becomes revoked version 2. Invalidation removes a cache entry, but cannot cancel the old read already in flight.

steps.title: The late version 1 fill arrives
steps.explanation: install(oldRead) returned true. The selected bounded policy permits this old snapshot until its original t=30 deadline. It does not get a new t=36 deadline.

steps.title: The bounded stale redirect is visible
steps.explanation: At t=29 the original permission has not ended, so the service can still issue 302 from the stale cached mapping. This is the policy's accepted limitation.

steps.title: At equality the old permission ends
steps.explanation: now equals serveUntil, so the old snapshot is rejected. A fresh authority read sees revoked version 2 and produces 410; no stale-on-error extension is allowed.

steps.title: Replaying the old fill cannot renew it
steps.explanation: install(oldRead) now returned false. Cache insertion time never grants a fresh lease. A new request still sees 410.

scenarios.title: Expiry shortens the same cache permission
scenarios.summary: A ten-second expiry wins over the thirty-second lease. Request replay returns the original create result without reviving the link.

steps.title: The first redirect caps its cache permission
steps.explanation: The active link expires at t=10. min(t=30 lease, t=10 expiry) gives serveUntil t=10, so a cached permission cannot outlive the link.

steps.title: Just before expiry, a cache hit redirects
steps.explanation: At t=9 both now < expiresAt and now < serveUntil hold. The service issues 302 with no-store for the browser.

steps.title: Exactly at expiry, redirecting stops
steps.explanation: At t=10 the cache permission is unusable. The authoritative row still exists, but now < expiresAt is false, so the service returns 410. Cleanup timing is irrelevant.

steps.title: A lost create response replays without revival
steps.explanation: The same request replays code A0000001 (replayed=true). It creates no new row and does not change expiry. Resolving it still returns 410.
